g.text: I'm Aaryan Singh, a MERN stack developer. I build
platforms that bring AI into the product.

nations. It combines satellite fire telemetry (NASA FIRMS), ground-station
air quality (WAQI) and live weather data with a Gemini-powered copilot. It
detects hidden pollution hotspots and forecasts air-quality spikes across
